tone_principles: Acknowledge the lived experience before explaining the system
Answer the specific claim and state the evidence boundary
Offer a reviewable next step without pressuring the reviewer
Never expose private operational details in public replies

response_patterns.trigger: A reviewer names a specific practice that helped
response_patterns.template: Thank you for naming [practice]. We are glad it helped you [bounded outcome]. The part we value most is that the decision remained yours and the evidence remained visible.
response_patterns.example_response: Thank you for naming the viability check. We are glad it helped you separate a reversible test from a consequential commitment. The part we value most is that the decision remained yours and the evidence remained visible.

response_patterns.trigger: A reviewer expected autonomous execution or guaranteed growth
response_patterns.template: You expected [expectation], and the experience did not meet it. Cambium is designed around bounded, reviewable action rather than guaranteed autonomy. We should have made that distinction clearer. If you are willing, share [non-sensitive detail] through the support path so a human can review it.
response_patterns.example_response: You expected the system to launch the campaign without review, and it did not. Cambium is designed around gated, reviewable action rather than guaranteed autonomy. We should have made that distinction clearer.

response_patterns.trigger: A review alleges harmful action, data exposure, or authority misuse
response_patterns.template: We take this seriously. Please do not post account details here. Use the private incident channel with the reference [case ID]; a human reviewer will examine the event log and authority boundary.
response_patterns.example_response: We take this seriously. Please do not post account details here. Use the private incident channel with your case reference; a human reviewer will examine the event log and authority boundary.

platform_specific.response_length: One concise post plus private escalation if needed

do: State what is and is not verified
Move sensitive cases to a private human-reviewed channel
dont: Offer incentives for changing a review
Reveal identities, logs, or account state
